notRecordedReason: SRN.CC's 117-HAK reference corpus is not present in this environment: SRNCC_CORPUS_ROOT is unset and no corpus is available to the milestone-7 S8 slice. Every measured field below is therefore null. No value in this file was estimated, extrapolated, or invented. The non-null fields are structural constants taken from PLAN.md:229 and from the existing assertions in tests/SRN.CC.CorpusTests/CorpusIndexAcceptanceTests.cs, not measurements.

populate.coldIndexSource: CorpusIndexAcceptanceTests.VerifyCorpusIndexing_ExactCountsAndPerformanceAcceptance writes 'Corpus Cold Indexing Median Duration: <n>s across 3 runs.' to the test output; the three per-run durations are the values it sorts to obtain that median.
populate.idleSource: IdleWorkingSetTests.FullCorpusIndex_ThenThirtySecondsIdle_KeepsPrivateAndWorkingSetBelow750MiB prints 'privateBytes=<n> ... workingSetBytes=<n> ...' to the progress stream; copy those two values into idle.privateBytes and idle.workingSetBytes.
populate.environmentSource: Record the machine the run happened on: Environment.OSVersion, Environment.Version, %PROCESSOR_IDENTIFIER%, Environment.ProcessorCount, and the build configuration, matching docs/evidence/tableview-performance-baseline.json.
populate.note: Substitute SRNCC_REQUIRE_CORPUS='1' for SRNCC_RUN_CORPUS='1' to make a missing or non-existent SRNCC_CORPUS_ROOT a hard failure instead of an ignore; CorpusGate.IsRequired implies CorpusGate.IsEnabled, so the require flag alone is sufficient.
